name: Scion of the City (Prestige Class)
body:
There are some vigilantes who owe everything to a city, either for better or worse. Some are native born dwellers of the city, while others experienced life changing events there. No matter the reason, a scion of the city has a reason to stay there for the city’s benefit or misfortune. The actions of a scion of the city reach far more wide than those of others, affecting local events on a massive scale.

Role: A scion of the city is as much an adventurer as any others, but their focus is far more narrow, specializing in a particular location. While others may have general knowledge of many things, a scion of the city knows their city inside and out, being able to completely own their surroundings and manipulate the local landscape to their liking.

Alignment: While the ties to a city are strong for a scion of the city, their goals are often widely varied due to their reason for staying. Some scions of the city choose to elevate their chosen city, providing aid to those who need it most whenever they can. Other scions of the city instead choose to own their city, to revel in the power that comes from laying claim to it. Both are inexorably tied to the fates of their city, wishing to keep it thriving in order to continue their plans.

Requirements

To qualify to become a scion of the city, a character must fulfill all of the following requirements:

Base Attack Bonus: +.
Skills: Knowledge (local) 4 ranks, Sense Motive 4 ranks
Social Talents: Renown.
Special: A character must have lived in a city for at least 3 months studying it without having left it for more than a day.
Class Skills

The scion of the city’s class skills are Acrobatics (Dex), Appraise (Int), Bluff (Cha), Climb (Str), Craft (Int), Diplomacy (Cha), Disable Device (Dex), Disguise (Cha), Escape Artist (Dex), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (local) (Int), Perception (Wis), Perform (Cha), Profession (Wis), Ride (Dex), Sense Motive (Wis), Sleight of Hand (Dex), Stealth (Dex), Survival (Wis), and Use Magic Device (Cha).

Skill Ranks per Level: 6 + Int modifier.

Table 11-3: Scion of the City
Level	Base Attack Bonus	Fort Save	Ref Save	Will Save	Special
1st	+0	+0	+1	+1	Social talent, scion city, vigilante training
2nd	+1	+1	+1	+1	Always armed, favored terrain
3rd	+2	+1	+2	+2	Vigilante talent
4th	+3	+1	+2	+2	Incredible renown, social talent
5th	+3	+2	+3	+3	City Stalker
6th	+4	+2	+3	+3	Local crew, vigilante talent
7th	+5	+2	+4	+4	Eyes of the city, social talent
8th	+6	+3	+4	+4	Scion renown
9th	+6	+3	+5	+5	Vigilante talent, we are the city
10th	+7	+3	+5	+5	Heart of the city, social talent
Class Features

The following are class features of the scion of the city prestige class.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

A scion of the city gains no proficiency with any weapons or armor.

Scion City (Ex)

At 1st level, a scion of the city selects a single settlement as their scion city. This settlement must have at least qualify as a small city, although they can select a large city or metropolis if desired. Many of the scion of the city’s class abilities will have additional effects inside of their scion city, but not in other locations. While a scion of the city may not have enough renown to affect their entire scion city, they gain the benefits of the triumphant return social talent when trying to build renown in an area of their scion city. A scion of the city must choose their scion city as their area of their renown (or at least part of it) and cannot maintain two areas of renown unless both are in the same city.

While inside of their scion city, a scion of the city receives a bonus on all Knowledge (local) checks pertaining to things happening inside of their city equal to half their scion of the city level. They also gain the great renown social talent.

A scion of the city can spend 3 months inside of a new city to designate it as their scion city, although they lose any benefits they may have gained from this prestige class inside of their former scion city.

Vigilante Training (Ex)

A scion of the city adds their scion of the city levels to their vigilante level for the purpose of their vigilante specialization and all effects related to social and vigilante talents. If the character had an archetype that traded their vigilante specialization or vigilante talents for another class feature (such as brute form), this class feature advances those as if they had gained another level in vigilante.

If a character had gained spellcasting through a vigilante archetype (such as magical child), they can choose to advance that spellcasting as though their scion of the city levels were vigilante levels. If they do so, the scion of the city does not gain the vigilante talent class feature of this prestige class.

Social Talent: At 1st level and every 3 levels afterwards, a scion of the city gains a social talent, adding their scion of the city level to their vigilante level to determine which social talents they can select.

Always Armed (Ex)

At 2nd level, a scion of the city gains the environmental weapon vigilante talent. If they already possessed this vigilante talent they trade it out for another vigilante talent they could have qualified for when they gained environmental weapon. While inside their scion city, they increase the damage die size of any improvised weapon they wield by 1 step and increase the critical range on improvised weapons by 1 (this increase does stack with other increases to the critical range, although it is applied last).

Favored Terrain (Ex)

At 2nd level, a scion of the city treats their scion city as their favored terrain as per the ranger class feature. At 6th level and again at 10th, the bonus from their favored terrain increases by +2.

Vigilante Talent: At 3rd level and every 3 levels thereafter, the scion of the city gains a vigilante talent, adding their scion of the city level to their vigilante level to determine which vigilante talents they can select.

Incredible Renown (Ex)

At 4th level, a scion of the city gains the incredible renown social talent. While inside of their scion city, they are treated as though they had the instant recognition talent.

City Stalker (Ex)

At 5th level, a scion of the city gains the hide in plain sight vigilante talent. If they already possessed this vigilante talent they trade it out for another vigilante talent they could have qualified for when they gained hide in plain sight. While inside their scion city, they do not have to be within 10 ft. of dim light to use this talent.

Local Crew (Ex)

At 6th level, a scion of the city gains the loyal aid social talent. If they already possessed this social talent they trade it out for another social talent they could have qualified for when they gained loyal aid. While inside their scion city, the scion of the city gains a number of followers as though they had the Leadership feat, gaining a bonus to their effective leadership score equal to half their scion of the city level. These follows are counted separately if the scion of the city has the Leadership feat and will not leave the city.

Eyes of the City (Ex)

At 7th level, a scion of the city gains the gossip collector social talent. If they already possessed this social talent they trade it out for another talent they could have qualified for when they gained loyal aid. While inside their scion city, the scion of the city becomes aware of any large shifts in power or important events inside of their scion city within 1 hour of them happening (subject to GM discretion).

Scion Renown (Ex)

At 8th level, a scion of the city can gain renown in a single community of up to 50,000 individuals (a metropolis). If the scion of the city’s scion city’s population is larger than 50,000, they choose to increase the population to which their renown is known by 25,000 individuals (up to the metropolis’s population) in place of gaining a social talent from any source. If the scion of the city has the celebrity discount talent, the gp limit of that talent increases to 16,000 gp.

We are the City (Ex)

At 9th level, a scion of the city and their local crew gain the Shared Identity feat without needing a dual identity (this does not allow the scion of the city to assume the identity of individuals in their local crew if they possess one). Individuals in the scion of the city’s local crew can only use this feat if explicitly told to do so by the scion of the city, and the scion of the city can choose to have any number of their local crew impersonate their vigilante identity, although a scion of the city must wait 1 week before having an individual use this ability again.

Heart of the City (Ex)

At 10th level, a scion of the city has become a figure of legend among the community, able to alter the city as they wish. Once a week, a scion of the city can select either their scion city’s corruption, crime, economy, law, lore or society settlement modifier, increasing or decreasing this score by 1 (up to an amount equal to the original modifier), although they have to wait 1 month before affecting the same settlement modifier again. A scion of the city can spend 1 month with their local crew to grant their scion city one settlement advantage or disadvantage or change its alignment by 1 step, during which time they cannot use their local crew for anything else. A scion of the city can only apply one settlement advantage or disadvantage and one alignment change to their scion city at a time, and their scion city loses any changes to its settlement modifiers, advantage or disadvantage, or new alignment if the scion of the city leaves the city for 6 months or longer.
